newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms on futures, but trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms on futures, but trade quiet.

text.p: NWE gas oil firmed on Friday in line with benchmark IPE futures but premiums were little changed in a lacklustre end-of-the-week market, traders said.
July gas oil was trading $1.50 higher at $164.00 a tonne at 1130 GMT.
Trading on the heating oil barge market was muted in the wake of the expiry of the IPE June gas oil contract as players re-positioned themselves.
Some 136,000 tonnes of material was delivered into the June contract. A Wall Street trader was seen as the main supplier and a German trader as the main recipient.
Heating oil barge premiums were assessed at July +50 cents/+$1.00 fob ARA for second half June delivery.
Low sulphur diesel premiums were little changed at around July IPE +$6.0/+$7.0 fob ARA.
Cargoes were steady with Russian material quoted around July IPE flat/+50 cents fob ARA.
0.2 percent material into Germany was assessed around July IPE +50 cents/+$1.50 fob ARA. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
